Review complete — **rejected**.

The diff claims to restore PROGRESS.md history that was silently lost in the PR 607 merge, but it deletes a different, real task-history section in the process: the entire `# PROGRESS -- task-20260727-153107-re-audit-projexa-erp-e2e-for-100pct-comp` section. I verified this directly against git (`git cat-file` on the actual parent and this commit, not the pasted diff): 9 section headers before, 8 after, with 153107 the one missing, and no trace of "153107" or "projexa_erp_e2e_reaudit" left anywhere in the file. That section documented a real completed audit of 5 PRs, and its corresponding report file (`ai-os/audits/projexa_erp_e2e_reaudit_2026-07-27.md`) still exists on disk, confirming it wasn't placeholder content.

This is the exact same content-loss bug class the commit's own message claims to fix, reintroduced by the fix itself — and the worker's self-report in PROGRESS.md never mentions removing it. Verdict and issues written to `review-verdict.json`.
